title: Global flows for the cubic nonlinear Schrödinger equation without decay assumptions
summary: For each positive integer $N$, we construct global spectral group actions for the defocusing and focusing nonlinear Schrödinger hierarchies on initial-data classes containing $W^{2N+1,\infty}(\mathbb R)$. For $N\ge2$, the quadratic flow gives global classical cubic NLS solutions. The construction extends the Sato--Segal--Wilson and Kotani frameworks to matrix Dirac systems; a homogeneous tau-function identity supplies the focusing positivity.
